SELECT sc.type AS seatType, tsc.carriage_number AS carriageNumber, s.seat_no AS seatNo FROM seat_class sc INNER JOIN train_seat_class tsc ON sc.id = tsc.seat_class_id INNER JOIN seat s ON tsc.id = s.train_seat_class_id INNER JOIN train_stop_station tss_a ON tsc.train_id = tss_a.train_id INNER JOIN train_stop_station tss_b ON tsc.train_id = tss_b.train_id INNER JOIN station s_start ON tss_a.station_id = s_start.id INNER JOIN station s_end ON tss_b.station_id = s_end.id WHERE tsc.train_id = #{trainId} AND sc.type = #{seatType} AND s_start.code = #{departureCode} AND s_end.code = #{arrivalCode} AND tss_a.sequence < tss_b.sequence
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seat_interval_occupy sio
LEFT JOIN pre_order po ON sio.order_id = po.id AND sio.order_type = 0
WHERE sio.seat_id = s.id AND ( -- 规则1：正式订单 → 永久有效 ( sio.order_type = 1 AND sio.status = 1 ) -- 规则2：预订单 → 未过期 + 未转正式订单 OR ( sio.order_type = 0 AND sio.status = 0 AND sio.expire_time > NOW() AND po.status = 0 ) )
AND tss_a.sequence < sio.end_sequence -- 目标出发站 < 占用区间终点 AND tss_b.sequence > sio.start_sequence -- 目标到达站 > 占用区间起点 ) -- 按车厢号+座位号排序，确保返回结果有序 ORDER BY tsc.carriage_number, s.seat_no LIMIT #{requiredCount} -- 限制返回数量
